title: CMS instance config
description: cms.config.json of a CMS instance (client site). Read and validated by the API on startup (unknown keys fail); mirrors api-backend/Services/Cms/CmsConfig.cs.

publicAuth.description: Customer accounts (register / login at /login). Off: the customer auth API answers 404 and the screens are gone.

lang.description: <html lang> of the site (BCP 47 tag, e.g. de, en-GB). Set at frontend build time by the cms() Vite plugin: rebuild after changing it.

exclude.description: Built-in block names hidden from the editor's inserters (existing content still renders and edits).

pages.description: Pages the CMS seeds, published: all on a fresh install, locked/template pages on every start when missing. Omitted: Home, Privacy Policy, Legal.

siteConfig.description: Shape of the owner's site config (admin Configuration): fixed fields and groups of entries, added to the core ones (field firmName, group contact; same key replaces them). Instance code reads config.fields.<key> / config.groups.<key>.

slug.description: Kebab-case, 1-100 characters; `home` is served at /. Not a reserved app route (login, admin, ...).

template.description: Template that renders the page: src/templates/<template>.vue in the instance app (props: page, config). Implies locked.

locked.description: Slug fixed and page undeletable (the site's code relies on it).

editable.description: false: the template renders everything and the owner can't edit blocks (requires a template).

footer.description: Linked in the public footer while published, in config order.

blocks.description: Initial content (block tree), seeded once. Attributes: string, number or boolean values.

type.description: Rendering hint (input type, mailto/tel/link). Not address.

presets.description: Entries the owner picks from; key and type fixed.

defaults.description: Preset keys a fresh config starts with.

required.description: Preset keys that can't be removed.

allowCustom.description: Owner may add entries with their own name and type.
